note: Daily scan 28 Nov: US fires on a blockade-runner, Trump at Al Dhafra; 17 tankers hit in Hormuz in November, though escorted traffic edges up.

signals.source: Gulf News / Khaleej Times / TradeArabia: UAE business and utilities
signals.summary: On 27 Nov Trump said 'victory is at hand', with timing his decision, and spoke to US troops at Al Dhafra Air Base. The US struck a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman enforcing its blockade, and Iran's military vowed to break it. Iran denied the Kuwait drone attack and offered a joint probe. A drone strike on the Jazan refinery killed a worker.
signals.check: US forces are now firing on blockade-runners and a US base in the Al Dhafra region is in focus. Check site security and access plans for assets near Al Dhafra Air Base, and keep crisis alert levels as set.
signals.notes: Opened Gulf News live coverage (27 Nov, grade C). No attacks on the UAE. Relevant to ER-02; follows SQ-0106 and SQ-0107.

signals.source: News wires: Reuters, AFP, DPA (via republishing sites)
signals.summary: JMIC's 26 Nov advisory counts 17 tankers struck in Hormuz since 1 Nov and keeps the threat at severe; the tanker Kun Peng was hit and set on fire off Oman on 26 Nov. Despite this, Vortexa data show energy tanker traffic slightly up on October, with US-assisted transits about 32 a day. Overall traffic stays below 2025, and anchorages are congested.
signals.check: Ships are still moving under US escort but with heavy anchorage congestion. Keep tracking delivery dates for critical spares; no new action beyond SQ-0110.
signals.notes: Opened SAFETY4SEA (27 Nov) citing JMIC, Vortexa via Bloomberg, and UKMTO. Source not in the list; nearest listed name used. Context for ER-01.
